data.turoyo: <...> Lə kowe, d nošo mqarəš bas səryoye abadan.
data.translation: <...> It is not permissible for anyone ever to interfere with the Syriacs.

rationale: Fourth Infectum example, with b-marked human group in a prohibition; source claim is quoted discourse. English is the supplied project machine translation, not an edition translation; interpretation rests on the Turoyo.
